purpose: Reviewed requirement manifest: test value is regression protection, not case count. Existing weaknesses and conditional proposals are explicit; no candidate is implemented by this review.

status_semantics.green: Last retained native comparison passed within stated scope
status_semantics.known-red: Last retained report matches exact reviewed failure policy; test exists, implementation defect remains
status_semantics.audit first: Identify missing protection and independent expectation before implementing
status_semantics.worth implementing: Concrete integration/behaviour gap; expectation and stopping rule stated
status_semantics.skip: No distinct protection or original requirement established

implemented_families.title: Continuous core replays
implemented_families.behaviour: Serve and continuous R1/R2 state, event order and transitions
implemented_families.regression: Arithmetic, update-order, scoring or dispatch drift
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Frozen repeated original callback records
implemented_families.stopping_condition: Retain uninterrupted comparisons through their defined endings; known failures remain explicit
implemented_families.limits: Core harness regenerates translated routines and always calls the gameplay sequence plus tail. It does not exercise the maintained application dispatcher/main loop. Baseline comparisons stop at the first mismatch; no full native match protection is established.
implemented_families.test_subject: Generated translated 68000 routines in fixed-dispatch simulation harness

implemented_families.title: Local wait/resume/restart phases
implemented_families.behaviour: Local source-state comparisons during recorded tail/wait and resume/restart intervals; exposes fixed-gameplay harness divergence
implemented_families.regression: Wrong callback regime or state reset
implemented_families.independent_expectation: Slices validated against original continuous parents
implemented_families.stopping_condition: One continuous comparison per distinct regime
implemented_families.limits: The harness calls gameplay even for original tail-only callbacks. These cases diagnose that mismatch; they do not test actual application tail dispatch. Some reference intervals extend beyond the executed prefix.
implemented_families.worth: keep as diagnostics; review overlap with I06
implemented_families.test_subject: Generated translated 68000 routines in fixed-dispatch simulation harness
